obelisk wrote:
> Since she's playing it as though she were a member of that clan, she
> would be considered a guruhi for the duration of the action, if I'm
> not mistaken. That said, I am not you know who...

close. The "The Guruhi Are The Land" (TGATL)card, and only that card,
considers her a Guruhi for the duration of the action. Nothing else in
the game will consider her Guruhi during that action. ONLY the TGATL
card she has played.

Which is why she can do it on an action to equip with the Ankara
Citadel. The Ankara Citadel card considers her to be a Tremere. But that
is th eonly card that considers here a Tremere. She can then play TGATL,
and the TGATL will see her as Guruhi. But the Ankara is still seeing her
as Tremere. And every other vampire, library card and effect in the game
will consider her Ravnos.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <4687938d$1...@dnews.tpgi.com.au>, Salem

<salem_ch...@hotmail.com> writes:
>close. The "The Guruhi Are The Land" (TGATL)card, and only that card,
>considers her a Guruhi for the duration of the action. Nothing else in
>the game will consider her Guruhi during that action. ONLY the TGATL
>card she has played.

Play and resolution of the card, not duration of the action.

Compare with Kemintiri playing Closed Session. For example:
http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/571e93365e932a10

Be careful when reading that thread, as LSJ rules the opposite in a
number of posts until Josh points out the problem.

With Guruhi are the Land, if you play the card early in the action and
the effect lingers around, it doesn't appear to work. However, I'm not
sure if there's any difference if you play it at the end of a successful
equip action and so would untap straight away - or whether it's a
lingering effect in much the same way as Closed Session, and it just
happens to linger for a fraction of a second.

seems to be instant from LSJ's post elsewhere in this current thread, as
long as you're playing it at the end of the action (except the bleed
bit, which can be played at any time, which seems weird to me).

Enter ramble mode:
I would have thought TGATL + bleed would follow the same sort of thing
as, say, superior Foreshadowing Destruction, where you only get +3 bleed
as long as the person you are bleeding has less than 10 pool. so you
play it on your action, and if they gain some pool and get over 10, then
it is no longer 'active' unless they spend back down below 10 pool
during that action. would have thought TGATL give the guruhi +1 bleed.
but only as long as they are guruhi, so after resolving the effect on
Mata, she stops being guruhi for that action, and thus loses the
conditional +1 bleed. Unless cards that say "this X gains Y while Z"
stop checking for X as soon as it's resolved, but keep checking for the
Z the whole way through. Which would cover TGATL (there is no Z to
check) and Foreshadowing (there is no X to check).
